meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:

These control excess sebum, clear out gunked-up pores, and prevent breakouts without stripping your skin barrier.

  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%28217.9K%29%20Simple.%20Refreshing%20Facial%20Wash%2C%20100%25%20Soap-Free,Acne.%202%20Sizes.%20Oily%20Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.)

  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Best%20for%3A%20All%20skin%20types.%20Rating%3A%208.5%2F10.,best%20face%20cleanser%20for%20face%20in%20India%3F)

  * **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea Extracts, Glycolic Acid[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.)
  * **Why buy it:** A cult favorite in India. It contains antioxidant-rich green tea to calm inflammation and gentle glycolic acid for light chemical exfoliation.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.) It leaves the skin feeling clean, refreshed, and matte without feeling tight or squeaky-dry.

### 3. Best for Daily Gentle Oil Control & Open Pores

  *   * **Price:** ~₹299[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** 1% Salicylic Acid, 2% Niacinamide
  * **Why buy it:** Combining two powerhouse ingredients, this face wash tackles excess oil and treats acne while niacinamide works parallelly to soothe redness and tighten the appearance of enlarged pores over time.

### 4. Best Classic Budget Option

* **Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%20Minimalist%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Wash,Vitamin%20C%20%2B%20E%20Brightening%20Face%20Wash.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹450 – ₹499 (often on discount on online platforms)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=Their%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%20face%20wash%20is,People%20with%20dry%20patches%20or%20sensitive%20skin.)
  * **Why buy it:** A globally trusted formulation that lathers well, deeply cleanses the skin of grime and grease, and prevents clogged pores.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=Their%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%20face%20wash%20is,People%20with%20dry%20patches%20or%20sensitive%20skin.) A small amount goes a long way, making a tube last a long time.

---

### Quick Tip for Oily Skin:

Even if your face feels like an oil slick, **do not over-wash it** (stick to twice a day). Washing more than that triggers your skin to produce even *more* oil to compensate. Always follow up with a lightweight, oil-free gel moisturizer.

items.markdown: Even if your face feels like an oil slick, **do not over-wash it** (stick to twice a day). Washing more than that triggers your skin to produce even *more* oil to compensate. Always follow up with a lightweight, oil-free gel moisturizer.
